Privacy policy

Last updated November 19, 2026

What I collect

When you use the contact form, I receive the name, email, phone number, website, and message you enter. This site doesn't use advertising trackers or sell any information.

How I use it

Only to reply to you and to work on your project. If you check the text-message box, I may text you about your project. Reply STOP at any time to opt out. I never share your phone number for marketing.

How long I keep it

Messages are kept in my business email for as long as they're useful for your project, and you can ask me to delete them at any time.

Contact

Questions? Email hello@tucsonwebdevelopment.net or call (520) 331-0035.
